findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 7 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Computer Science Board shape (8 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 17 questions numbered 1-17; by section: u-meaning-of-hypothesis 1, u-research-questions-and-hypotheses 1, u-role-of-hypothesis-testing-in-data-analysis 1, u-null-hypothesis-h0 1, u-formulating-correct-hypotheses 1, u-test-statistics 2, u-critical-region 1, u-p-value-and-its-importance 1, u-advanced-tests-f-test-and-chi-square-test 2, u-graphs-and-charts-for-presenting-results 1, u-importance-of-data-visualization 1, u-bias-in-data-collection-and-analysis 1, u-ethical-use-of-data-and-models 1, u-interpreting-test-results 1, u-presenting-findings-clearly 1.

Covers hypothesis vs hypothesis testing, the hypothesis function, research questions, null and alternative hypotheses with decision wording, formulating and correcting hypotheses, test statistics with a t-value numerical, a chi-square numerical, critical region and significance level, p-value decisions, a full seven-step t-test with changed data, the F-test and chi-square test with an F numerical, choosing charts and linking visuals with hypotheses, visualization before and after testing, bias types in new situations, ethical use of data and models, interpreting and connecting conclusions, and writing clear findings. The exercise's long questions are not repeated. Every number was computed in Python (one-tailed p-value found by numerical integration of the t-distribution). Book corrections followed: chi-square as the Greek chi, the worked example's one-tailed p-value (about 0.000012, not the printed two-tailed 0.00002), alpha and H0/H1 as symbols.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
